description: Normalization ranges for continuous metrics. Values are clipped to [0, 1] after normalization.
formula: normalized = (value - min) / (max - min), then clipped to [0, 1]

notes.inverted_metrics: For flesch_kincaid, ari, and dale_chall, lower raw values are better (easier to read), so we invert after normalization: normalized = 1 - normalized
notes.readability_aggregation: Readability metrics are averaged into a single 'readability' predictor
